title: November Pixel Drop update available
description:
Your Pixel is getting better with the latest features and enhancements. Learn more on our Community page.

What's new?

• Voice typing just got a major upgrade. Rambler can automatically remove filler words like “um,” and format your thoughts into clear, polished text. [1]

• Pixel 10 designed for Gemini Intelligence. Get personalized help with everyday tasks so you can easily find info, take action, and brainstorm ideas. [1]

• Your phone can even anticipate more of your needs and help you take action with a tap. Offload routine tasks to Gemini – like booking a ride and summarizing text. [2]

• Create custom widgets, like a spending tracker or a game day widget with team colors. Your home screen can be as personalized as you want it to be. [2]

• Give your phone a makeover with brand-new custom icon styles. Redesign all your home screen icons with a consistent look.

• Transit Mode now can turn on automatically when your phone detects you’re on a train. It adjusts your sound, turns on Bluetooth, and can turn on Motion Assist for smoother browsing. [3]

• Pixel search helps you find what you need across your phone, from vacation photos and recent emails to messages, calendar events, and device settings. [4]

• Extreme Charging Mode now supported on more devices. [5]

• Message notification summaries and organizer now in more countries and languages. [6]


[1] Available for select countries and languages to users 18+. Feature availability will vary; some features may require subscription for higher usage. Some features available on Gemini app. Check responses. Not available on Pixel 10a phones.

[2] Available for select devices, countries, and languages to users 18+. Feature availability will vary; may require subscription for higher usage. Check responses.

[3] Automatic train detection and Motion Assist in Transit Mode are off by default and can be turned on in Settings.

[4] Available for select devices, countries, and languages to users 18+. Feature availability will vary; may require subscription for higher usage. Some features require setup or connected apps. Check responses.

[5] Available on Pixel 10 and newer except Pixel 10a.

[6] Available on Pixel 9 and newer phones (excluding Pixel 9a and Pixel 10a) in select countries and languages.


Downloading updates over a cellular network, metered Wi-Fi, or while roaming may cause additional charges.
